title: RoboSense: Large-scale Dataset and Benchmark for Egocentric Robot Perception and Navigation in Crowded and Unstructured Environments
reasoning: The paper focuses on the development of a multimodal dataset and benchmark for robot perception (LiDAR, camera, etc.) in crowded environments. While it mentions data privacy desensitization as a safety measure, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
